scene_prompt: Modern utility room. Adult keeps mopping up puddles under leaking water pipe, clearing a small dry patch, but water steadily sprays downward from visibly loose pipe joint and refills puddle. A second adult points toward the supply shutoff valve above, still left open and untouched, showing root cause unaddressed. alt: 大人不斷拖乾地板，漏水接頭卻繼續把水灑回地上；同伴指著仍未關閉的供水閥，旁邊水桶已裝滿。
